instructions: Review every item independently in the given order. Historical provenance, evidence class, source-verification and mutation records are withheld.

items.source: You have %d%% chances to encase your foes in iceblocks.
items.target: 你造成伤害时有 %d%% 几率将敌人封入冰块 3 回合；效果持续期间，冰块吸收的伤害降低 50%。

items.source: [%sEquip %s%s#LAST#]
items.target: [%s卸下 %s%s#LAST#]

items.source: Direct control by the pilot increases damage by %d%% and resistances by %d%%.
items.target: 机械蜘蛛被驾驶员直接控制，增加全部伤害 %d%%，增加全部抗性 %d%%；每回合使包括固定冷却在内的所有技能额外减少 1 回合冷却。

items.source: Master which tool?
items.target: 分解哪件工具？

items.source: Infected by a psionic worm, doing %0.2f mind damage per turn. Damage doubled on stunned or feared foes, can spread to nearby creatures.
items.target: 目标被灵能蠕虫感染，每回合受到 %0.2f 点精神伤害。对震慑或恐惧的敌人伤害加倍，可传播给半径 3 内尚未感染且与宿主同阵营的单位；宿主死亡时必然传播，否则每回合有 25% 几率传播。

items.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You are given: %s
items.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你失去了：%s

items.source: The target is surrounded by a charged shield, absorbing %d/%d damage before it crumbles. While this holds, they will project a bolt of lightning against a random enemy within range 7 each turn for %0.2f lightning damage.
items.target: 目标被充能护盾覆盖，在破碎前可以吸收 %d/%d 伤害。当护盾存在时，他们每回合会朝 6 码范围内的随机敌人发射闪电弹，造成 %0.2f 闪电伤害。

items.source: The target is very itchy, causing their actions to fail.
items.target: 太痒了，技能有几率施放失败。

items.source: You lay moss where you walk.
items.target: 成功自行移动到新位置后，会在该处铺设缠绕苔藓；站在其上的敌人会受到自然伤害、移动减速，并可能被定身。

items.source: All damages except physical reduced by %d as long as %s is alive.
items.target: 只要%s还存活，受到的所有非物理伤害降低 %d 点。

items.source: Provides a frost aura, giving you +%d%% blight, mind and acid affinity.
items.target: 提供静水光环，使你获得 +%d%% 枯萎、精神和酸性的亲和。

items.source: The target has %d increased saves and defense, and %d%% increased critical chance.
items.target: 目标豁免和闪避增加 %d（从 1 层起即如数增加），暴击率增加 %d%%（始终增加）。

items.source: Reduces all damage taken by %d%%.
items.target: 减少 %d%%所有受到的伤害。

items.source: #CADET_BLUE#Equipping %s with %s (level %d).
items.target: #CADET_BLUE#将 %s 装备至 %s（等级 %d）。

items.source: Engaged in automated repairs, preventing any action but increasing life regen by %d, all resistances by %d%% and preventing death until falling below -%d life.
items.target: 进入自动修复模式，无法行动，但生命恢复速率增加 %d ，生命值回满时立即结束该模式，全部抗性提升 %d%%，死亡生命下限为 -%d 。

items.source: The target is overwhelmed by voices from the void, giving them a 20%% higher chance to spawn hallucinations from Dark Whispers and causing them to take an additional %d%% temporal damage from Dark Whispers and Hideous Visions.
items.target: 目标被虚空之声淹没 , 让他们从黑暗低语中产生幻觉的几率增加 20%%，并使他们从黑暗低语和失智冲击中受到额外 %d%% 时空伤害。

items.source: Deals %0.2f occult damage per turn and each time a talent is used, the caster regens one turn of a random cooldown.
items.target: 每回合施加者沿至多10格的链接射线，对射线上的生物造成 %0.2f 玄机伤害；施加者不存在或距离超过10格时效果结束且不造成伤害；目标使用非固有技能时，施加者优先随机缩短一个冷却中的法术1回合，没有则随机缩短一个冷却中的科技法术1回合。

items.source: Continuously drain blood, dealing %0.2f physical damage per turn and healing the caster for half of it.
items.target: 持续汲取目标的鲜血，每回合造成 %0.2f 点物理伤害；若施加者距离过远、死亡或不在场，链接立即断开且本回合不造成伤害；造成伤害后，施加者获得相当于该伤害一半的治疗，同回合多个目标的治疗量不会递减。

items.source: Target is being assailed by an automated saw blade that cuts its flesh for %0.2f physical damage each turn%s. When the effect expires, the saw will explode for %0.2f fire damage and fly back to its source, pulling the target with it (up to %d tiles).
items.target: 你被飞锯击伤，每回合受到 %0.2f 物理伤害 %s。仅当持续时间自然结束且施加者仍在场时，飞锯才会爆炸，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害并飞回其来源；即使无法被击退，也会被拉向施加者（最多 %d 格）。

items.source: [Equip %s]
items.target: [装备 %s]

items.source:
The target is engulfed in entropy, reducing the duration of new beneficial effects and increasing the duration of new negative effects by %d%%.
This effect will fade in 2 turns if the source is not in line of sight.
items.target:
目标被熵覆盖，仅缩短新施加的非“其他”类有益状态并延长新施加的非“其他”类负面状态 %d%% 持续时间（不影响“其他”类效果）。
若效果来源不在视野内，则该效果会在 2 回合后消失。

items.source: The target has tied itself to the fate of another. If it dies, it's chosen target will die in it's place and it will be healed by %d for each stack of Fortune and Jinx.
items.target: 目标将自身的命运和另一个人相连，当它死亡时，选择的目标将代替它死亡。 此时，自身的幸运层数和所选目标身上的不幸层数会被消耗；按自身的幸运层数与所选目标的不幸层数之和治疗，每层恢复 %d 点生命。

items.source: Reduces all damage taken by %d%% and remove all detrimental effects on application.
items.target: 降低所有受到的伤害 %d%%。施加该效果的时候会解除所有负面效果

items.source: %s[%s -- mastery: %s]#LAST#
items.target: %s[%s -- 强化：%s]#LAST#

items.source: All resistances increased by %d%%, randomly attacks two foes each turn at random.
items.target: 全部抗性提高 %d%%，两把蒸汽枪每回合各自随机选择一名敌人攻击（不会攻击同一目标），持有者被缴械。

items.source: The target has been impregnated with %d developing ritch larvae which are feeding on it%s.  After a %d turn gestation period, each will burst out violently, dealing %0.2f physical and %0.2f fire damage to its host.
items.target: 目标被 %d 个里奇幼虫寄生%s。在%d回合的发育期结束后，每个幼虫都会从寄主体内猛烈破体而出，对宿主造成 %0.2f 物理和 %0.2f 火焰伤害；效果提前解除时，幼虫不会破体而出。

items.source: [Cancel]
items.target: [取消]

items.source: Cancel
items.target: 取消

items.source: %d pustules increasing resistance by %d%%.
items.target: %d 脓包，增加 %d%% 仅物理抗性。

items.source: #CADET_BLUE#%s already equipped at level %d.
items.target: #CADET_BLUE#%s 尚未装备，等级 %d。

items.source: #CADET_BLUE#%s already mastered.
items.target: #CADET_BLUE#%s 尚未强化。

items.source: Equip which tool for #YELLOW#%s#LAST#?
items.target: 为 #YELLOW#%s#LAST# 拆解哪件工具？

items.source:
Bringing about the darkest days of the Spellblaze you hasten the death of your foes.
		When you deal damage to a creature in radius %d or less around you and it dips below 33%% life you automatically unleash the fury of the Spellblaze.
		Affected foes will start taking %0.2f darkness damage each turn until it dies as long as it remains in radius %d of you.
		The damage increases with spellpower.
items.target:
通过引发魔法大爆炸最黑暗的时候的场景，你加速了敌人的死亡。
		每次你对半径 %d 内的生物造成伤害后（实际触发范围会随该数值变化），如果它生命值低于 33%%，将会承受魔法大爆炸的力量。
		受影响的敌人每回合将受到 %0.2f 暗影伤害，直到死亡或者离开你范围 %d 码范围。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

items.source: #LIGHT_BLUE# You enhance your preparation of %s.
items.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# 你强化了对 %s 的准备。

items.source: %d%% chance to stun any foes hit.
items.target: %d%% 几率震慑被击中的敌人；每次符合条件的命中都按该几率判定，且同一目标每回合最多被震慑一次。

items.source: The target is doomed to treason. Each turn they have a %d%% chance to attack an adjacent creature.  If no creatures are adjacent they will attack themself.
items.target: 目标被诅咒进入背叛状态。每回合有 %d%% 几率立即触发背叛；若目标抵抗，该回合的累积速率减半（而非完全阻止）。当累积进度达到阈值时，目标会攻击一个相邻生物；若无相邻生物则攻击自身，触发后进度减少 100（而非清零），超出阈值的部分会保留并继续累积。
